mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated unemployment reflects economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings expectations and increases risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is low and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is low, the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as low rates and stable inflation create a favorable environment for risk-taking and equity growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL < 230, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are both above their 12-month moving averages, it indicates a robust consumer demand environment that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS are both above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 100 (the 2017 base year level), it signals strong economic output that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 130,000 thousand persons, it indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as strong consumer demand drives corporate revenue growth and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 390000, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 700 thousand units, it signals a strengthening housing market that boosts consumer confidence and economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 700, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
